about: compiler/tsffi: the flat FFI contract (validation, dense IDs) and its strict .d.ts emitter (NB-3-TS-FFI-BRIDGE round 1).

mutants.name: tsffi-intern-skips-new-text
mutants.rule: A new string's text is stored at its dense ID, so Text of an interned ID is the string.

mutants.name: tsffi-ident-digit-first
mutants.rule: An identifier may not start with a digit.

mutants.name: tsffi-distinct-never-equal
mutants.rule: A name declared twice in one scope is refused as duplicate.

mutants.name: tsffi-forward-ref-admitted
mutants.rule: A type refers only to types declared before it, so ID order is a definition order and no value type contains itself.

mutants.name: tsffi-void-value-admitted
mutants.rule: void is only a result, never a field, element, member or parameter.

mutants.name: tsffi-union-member-any-kind
mutants.rule: Union and failure members are records, so each carries its _tag.

mutants.name: tsffi-primitive-kind-unchecked
mutants.rule: The primitive types sit at IDs 0 to 8, each ID equal to its kind.

mutants.name: tsffi-nested-option-admitted
mutants.rule: An option of an option is refused: T | undefined cannot tell its two Nones apart.

mutants.name: tsffi-nominal-over-record
mutants.rule: A nominal type is over a scalar, string or bytes.

mutants.name: tsffi-empty-union-admitted
mutants.rule: A closed union has at least one member.

mutants.name: tsffi-result-ref-unchecked
mutants.rule: A function's result names a type of the contract.

mutants.name: tsffi-mut-on-any-kind
mutants.from: if c.Params.Mut[pi] && kind != KindBytes && kind != KindSlice {
mutants.rule: mut is only on bytes and slices, the parameters a callee can write through.

mutants.name: tsffi-shape-unchecked
mutants.rule: Every column of a table has the table's height.

mutants.name: tsffi-words-split-on-lower-only
mutants.rule: An acronym ends before the capital that starts the next word: HTTPServer is httpServer.

mutants.name: tsffi-member-reserved-unescaped
mutants.rule: A member spelling that is a reserved word gets a trailing _.

mutants.name: tsffi-int64-as-number
mutants.rule: 64-bit integers are bigint: a number loses integers past 2^53.

mutants.name: tsffi-option-in-slice-unparenthesized
mutants.rule: An option inside a slice is parenthesized, else T | undefined[] reads as a different type.

mutants.name: tsffi-slice-always-writable
mutants.rule: A slice the callee only reads is readonly T[]; only a mut parameter is T[].

mutants.name: tsffi-doc-close-unescaped
mutants.rule: A doc cannot close its comment early.

mutants.name: tsffi-reserved-type-admitted
mutants.rule: A contract type may not take a name the declarations use, such as Result.

mutants.name: tsffi-nominal-unbranded
mutants.from: b.WriteString("export type " + name + " = " + TSType(k, c.Types.Elem[id], false) + " & { readonly __brand: \"" + name + "\" };\n\n")
mutants.to: b.WriteString("export type " + name + " = " + TSType(k, c.Types.Elem[id], false) + ";\n\n")
mutants.rule: A nominal type is branded, so TypeScript keeps it apart from its base as Ergo does.

mutants.name: tsffi-record-untagged
mutants.rule: Every record carries readonly _tag, the discriminant of the unions and failure rows it is a member of.

mutants.name: tsffi-result-never-declared
mutants.rule: Result is declared when a function can fail.
